Name: Smaller Farmhouse Map
Author: Asterisk555
TagLine: Makes the farmhouse map as small as is practical
Description:
_Description_

*   Makes the farmhouse map as small as is practical

*   I made it for those times I want something cozier
_Compatibility_

*   Works in multiplayer if everyone has it installed

*   Should work with Multiple Spouses and Free Love

*   Not mobile compatible

*   Use [NoClip](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900)﻿ to retrieve any items of furniture that might be lost in the void

*   If you want Attic for the Farmhouse mod compatibility, or if you're marrying Olivia from SVE, use [Another Smaller Farmhouse](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11772) instead﻿

*   Works with [Bathroom replaces spouseroom](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12150), though you should uncheck "bachelor mode". You can then use [SpouseRoom Furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12187)﻿﻿ to set up your spouse's room somewhere else in the farmhouse if you want. If you want a bathroom "just for looks" use the furniture version included in my [big furniture pack](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12240) or [adorable cottage bathroom furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10982).﻿﻿

*   If using [industrial kitchen](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5351)﻿ set **"Kitchen fix manual switch": "true"** in your config.json
_Other mods I've made that work well with this one_

*   [Customisable Empty Spouse Rooms with NPC furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11641)

*   [Beam recolor mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11597)

*   [Crib flooring fix](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12602)﻿
I have a [kofi page](https://ko-fi.com/asteriskart)﻿﻿ if you'd like to donate to my future tiny house fund, or would like to commission some art
